policy: Everything in fiveStarPersonIdentityResearchAssociations is research only. Source name/title match and 5/5 rating do not establish that the photographed physical painting correctly depicts the saint or that it fits the day's Mass mystery.
The global 0–2 original blocklist was enforced in the earlier dated W63 index and none of these user5 entries crosses it; never show them again.
Commemorated saint art does not automatically replace the principal observed Mass hero.
Group feasts (Peter/Paul; Philip/James; Simon/Jude) may link individual Apostle artworks but an individual portrait does not count as an exact illustration of an entire joint feast.

Saint Peter, John, Joseph, Thomas, Philip and Lawrence disambiguated by explicit date plus literal owner-observed title; no matches to Peter Nolasco, Thomas Aquinas or Joseph of Cupertino by generic substring.
Multiple photo/original mismatches in the W49 user5 scores are retained but cannot be published until exact viewed-photo to object verification.
Do not infer that source liturgical nominal feasts superseded by Sunday are unillustrated; the Saints-of-Day tab may need imagery even when the saint is not the observed Mass principal.

Seven explicit source-date/person-name-variant matches added from the 365 DayResolver rows; each remains identity-owner-held. St Thérèse/Lisieux ↔ St Theresa Infant Jesus, St Ignatius Loyola, St Jean/John Mary Vianney, Archangel Raphael, Fabian/Sebastian group, Peter Damian/Damien, Ephrem/Ephrem of Syria. Do not treat the joined group member as full group-feast subject proof.
